# Traceability matrix — Gosling shared shell productization

Status vocabulary: `planned` → `built` → `verified`; or `deferred` / `cut` through an accepted plan-change record. `verified` requires revision-specific observed evidence.

Original baseline: `main` at `8627dc31a`
Reassessed baseline: merged `main` at `6fe6a3bfc`, 2026-08-13
Last updated: 2026-08-14, historical PG-50 accepted on exact revision `b921e6ee1299dba2207ab27ab6fd9452cc57aa26`; current Default Shell foundation requires fresh DS-7 acceptance before GUI work

The focused execution mapping for every pre-GUI R1–R4 requirement is in
[`pre-gui-backend-implementation-plan.md`](pre-gui-backend-implementation-plan.md). This matrix
remains the canonical SHP-REQ inventory and status vocabulary.

The detailed Default Shell mapping for SHP-REQ-044–053 is in
[`default-shell-ds3-ds7-implementation-plan.md`](default-shell-ds3-ds7-implementation-plan.md).

## Deferred/cut log

None at planning baseline. Any P0/P1 deferral or cut requires an operator-accepted plan-change record stating residual risk and impact on the definition of complete.
